Visual Studio Code completion icons

Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation and contributors.

The SVG files in src/editor/codicons are unchanged copies from
@vscode/codicons 0.0.46-40, the version locked by the supplied VS Code 1.140.0
reference. Only the completion icon subset is included. The original 16x16
artwork is rendered as CSS masks; no icon outlines have been redrawn.

Source: https://github.com/microsoft/vscode-codicons
Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/@vscode/codicons/-/codicons-0.0.46-40.tgz
Package integrity (SHA-512, base64):
sFaz0+i9FLHyqDY3/mjyYF4U8dyxcAWEqfZFF/4IQEZM/jjlbhRDOtDbHPe8P6nQktm6+QsuvlDhtOi4nSFSSQ==

The artwork is licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International:
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
The complete upstream license and warranty disclaimer are in LICENSE-ICONS.txt.
No Microsoft affiliation or endorsement is implied.

The TypeScript-kind adapter in SourceEditor.tsx and the light-theme symbol
colors in style.css are adapted from the following VS Code reference files.
Protocol constants and enum results are represented as local strings; the
renderer remains CodeMirror, with SVG masks rather than VS Code's icon font.
Selected icons inherit the existing selected-row foreground.

Source: https://github.com/microsoft/vscode
Reference snapshot: 1.140.0 (not asserted to identify an upstream commit)
